events.title: Patch v0.15.0 - Pet Crafting
events.summary: FeaturesAdded pet genome crafting. Pets can now be upgraded in the Pet Crafting Station - which is a new housing block. You can upgrade pets to level 5, where they will gain one RNG trait per level. Then you will be able to merge level 5 pets to merge their gene sequence. There are 77 unique genes that a pet can recieve. Some are genes more rare than others. Higher tier pets have improved chances of rolling higher tier genes. events.title: Patch v0.14.0 - Lag and Balance Improvements
events.summary: FeaturesAdd lag timewarping: The goal of this is to prevent lag switching attacks. Instead of squishing monster attacks during lag which can trivialize fights, instead we slightly speedup the game (1.25x - 2.0x speedup), until the client catches back upto the server. This means that if you are lagging badly, your character might freeze for a short period until they reconnect, and then you'll have to play through the scenario at a slightly faster rate. events.title: Patch v0.13.0 - Major Balance Changes
events.summary: Hello everyone, this is the first patch in likely what will be many balance patches starting now. For this one I mostly focused on getting player items and monster damage into the correct curves. It's definitely not perfect, but its a step in the right direction. That said, there is still a lot more balance changes that still need to be made.
